1. Long-press the clock on your home screen.\n2. Tap \"Add Custom Widget\".\n3. Scroll to \"Navigation Shortcuts\", tap it, then tap the widget preview.
Other launchers: long-press an empty spot on the home screen → Widgets → Navigation Shortcuts.
Open a place in Google Maps, tap Share and pick \"Add to widget\". Or tap your widget above and add one by address.
Tip: share any place from Google Maps to this app (Share → Add to widget).
